g.text: Mean coverage of case genes / pathways / cell types in retrieved literature (LLM-judged, qwen3.5:122b). Error bars: 95% bootstrap CI.
Retrieval coverage of case biology: skill ON vs OFF
Paired Wilcoxon, per-case ON−OFF. Cell types: significant in both strengths (pooled p<0.001, n=60).
Pathways: large effect but underpowered (11/30 cases annotated). Genes saturated. *p<0.05 **p<0.01 ***p<0.001
